title: Using safePivot in Shiny
text: safePivot provides drag--drop pivot-table widget Shiny applications. browser-side widget used interaction, R used reproducible computation export. recommended Shiny workflow : display widget safePivotOutput(); render renderSafePivot(); capture current pivot configuration input$<outputId>_config; recompute current pivot result R safe_pivot_compute_from_config(); export R-computed result CSV, Excel, RDS, RData helpers. design avoids scraping HTML table browser. Instead, browser sends pivot configuration back Shiny, R recomputes exported table original data.

title: Using safePivot in Shiny
code: library(shiny) library(safePivot)  ui <- fluidPage(   titlePanel("safePivot Shiny example"),   safePivotOutput("pivot", height = "650px") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$pivot <- renderSafePivot({     safePivot(       iris,       rows = "Species",       vals = "Sepal.Length",       aggregator = "Median",       renderer = "Table",       show_type_badges = TRUE     )   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

renderer = "Table",       show_type_badges = TRUE,       conditional_format = TRUE,       conditional_format_mode = "both"     )   })    output$pivot_config <- renderPrint({     input$pivot_config   })    current_pivot <- reactive({     safe_pivot_compute_from_config(       data = dat(),       config = input$pivot_config,       default_rows = "Species",       default_cols = NULL, function(file) {       safe_pivot_write_csv(         current_pivot(),         file,         which = "wide"       )     }   )    output$download_xlsx <- downloadHandler(     filename = function() { filename = function() {       "safePivot_result.RData"     },     content = function(file) {       safe_pivot_write_rdata(         current_pivot(),         file,         object_name = title: Using safePivot in Shiny
text: browser pivot table interactive. Users can move variables rows, columns, values, can change aggregator. Instead trying parse displayed HTML table, safePivot captures current configuration recomputes result R. gives three advantages: exported results generated original data; export logic testable R; Shiny apps need custom HTML-scraping code.

title: Using safePivot in Shiny
text: interactive browser table R-side export engine use aggregator names. means user can change pivot table browser export current result safe_pivot_compute_from_config(). safePivot distinguishes: example: example: Zero percentages use numeric non-missing values denominator: :
code: empty pivot cell  = no records exist for that row-column combination observed missing  = a record exists, but the selected value is NA observed zero     = a record exists and the selected numeric value is 0 quality_dat <- data.frame(   row = c("A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "C"),   col = c("X", "X", "Y", "X", "Y", "X"),   y = c(0, 1, NA, 0, 5, NA) )  safe_pivot_compute(   quality_dat,   rows = "row",   cols = "col",   vals = "y",   aggregator = "N missing" )$wide A × Y has one observed missing value, so N missing = 1. C × X has one observed missing value, so N missing = 1. C × Y has no records, so it remains NA. safe_pivot_compute(   quality_dat,   rows = "row",   cols = "col",   vals = "y",   aggregator = "Zero % within Cell" )$wide A × X has values 0 and 1, so Zero % within Cell = 50. A × Y has only NA, so Zero % within Cell = NA. C × X has only NA, so Zero % within Cell = NA. C × Y has no records, so it remains NA.

title: safePivot 0.1.1
text: Added explicit missing non-missing aggregators, including within-cell, row, column, total percentages. Added zero non-zero aggregators, including within-cell, row, column, total percentages. Clarified aggregation semantics: empty pivot cells treated data remain NA; observed NA values counted missing; numeric zero values counted separately missing values. Reworked Sum Fraction Total, Sum Fraction Rows, Sum Fraction Columns, Count Fraction Total, Count Fraction Rows, Count Fraction Columns denominators calculated explicit cell, row, column, total summaries.

title: safePivot 0.1.1
text: Added browser-side conditional formatting modes: "none", "value", "data_quality", "". Added styled Excel export heatmap-style colouring, zero cells, empty cells, high/low value highlighting. Added data-type badges draggable variable names PivotTable.js UI, including numeric, integer, character, factor, ordered factor, Date, date-time, logical, list, object types.

title: safePivot 0.1.0
text: Added safePivot(), htmlwidget wrapper around PivotTable.js drag--drop pivot tables R. Added Shiny support safePivotOutput() renderSafePivot(). Added R-side pivot computation safe_pivot_compute(). Added Shiny config-based export support safe_pivot_compute_from_config(). Added CSV, Excel, RDS, RData export helpers. Added support missing-value display missingness aggregators. Added support R factor-level ordering. Added row column totals /options. Added heatmap palettes browser-side conditional formatting. Added package examples, README quick-start, pkgdown website.
